files.role: Adds standard, source_standard_id, and alcohol_g columns to foodtracker.food_logs. Adds an index on source_standard_id. Safe to run on an already-migrated database (uses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS or equivalent).
migration_statements: ALTER TABLE foodtracker.food_logs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS standard BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
ALTER TABLE foodtracker.food_logs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_standard_id UUID NULL
ALTER TABLE foodtracker.food_logs ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS alcohol_g NUMERIC(7,1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_food_logs_source_standard_id ON foodtracker.food_logs (source_standard_id)

files.role: Sprint 04 standards management endpoints: PATCH /api/food/entries/{id}/standard, GET /api/food/standards, POST /api/food/standards/{standard_id}/log, DELETE /api/food/standards/{standard_id}/today-instance. Must not import from food.py, entries.py, or report.py.

methods.name: toggle_standard
methods.purpose: PATCH /api/food/entries/{id}/standard. Parses JSON body, extracts desired_standard (bool, required). Returns HTTP 422 if body invalid or desired_standard missing/wrong type. Checks id existence in foodtracker.food_logs; returns HTTP 404 if not found. Executes UPDATE SET standard = %s, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = %s. Commits. Returns StandardToggleResult {id, standard: desired_standard} as JSON HTTP 200.

methods.name: get_standards_page
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/standards. Executes two queries: (1) SELECT id, meal_type, dish_name, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, good_fat_g, meat_g, red_meat_g, sodium_mg, confidence FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE standard = TRUE ORDER BY meal_type, dish_name; (2) SELECT source_standard_id, dish_name, meal_type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(kcal) as total_kcal, SUM(protein_g) as total_protein_g, SUM(carbs_g) as total_carbs_g, SUM(fat_g) as total_fat_g, SUM(fiber_g) as total_fiber_g, SUM(good_fat_g) as total_good_fat_g, SUM(meat_g) as total_meat_g, SUM(red_meat_g) as total_red_meat_g, SUM(sodium_mg) as total_sodium_mg FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE source_standard_id IS NOT NULL AND logged_at::date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY source_standard_id, dish_name, meal_type ORDER BY MAX(logged_at) DESC. Returns StandardsPagePayload {standards, today_instances} as JSON HTTP 200.

methods.name: log_from_standard
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/standards/{standard_id}/log. SELECT * FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE id = %s; return HTTP 404 if not found. If row.standard is False, return HTTP 422 (NOT_A_STANDARD). Assign new_id = str(uuid.uuid4()). Set new_logged_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'). INSERT copying all nutrition columns (meal_type, dish_name, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, good_fat_g, meat_g, red_meat_g, sodium_mg, confidence, notes, alcohol_g) from source row plus id=new_id, logged_at=new_logged_at, standard=FALSE (firm rule), source_standard_id=standard_id. RETURNING *. Commits. Returns inserted row serialised by _serialise_standard_log_result as JSON HTTP 201.

methods.name: delete_today_instance
methods.purpose: DELETE /api/food/standards/{standard_id}/today-instance. Two-statement approach: (1) SELECT id FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE source_standard_id = %s AND logged_at::date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 1. If no row returned, return ApiError HTTP 404 (NO_TODAY_INSTANCE). (2) DELETE FROM foodtracker.food_logs WHERE id = %s using the returned id. Commits. Returns HTTP 204 No Content.

methods.name: _serialise_standard_log_result
methods.purpose: Converts a psycopg2 RealDictRow from the log_from_standard INSERT RETURNING into a Sprint 04 v1.1 EntryDetail dict. Serialisation rules: id as str, logged_at/created_at/updated_at as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' (naive, no timezone), kcal and confidence as int, all other numerics as float, notes as str or None, standard as bool, source_standard_id as str or None. Does not include alcohol_g in output (not returned in this slice). Private to standards.py — not importable by other modules.

methods.name: _serialise_standard_dish
methods.purpose: Converts a foodtracker.food_logs row (from the standards query in get_standards_page) into a StandardDish dict. Fields: id (str), meal_type (str), dish_name (str), kcal (int), protein_g/carbs_g/fat_g/fiber_g/good_fat_g/meat_g/red_meat_g/sodium_mg (float), confidence (int). Private to standards.py.

methods.name: _serialise_today_instance
methods.purpose: Converts a GROUP BY aggregate row (from the today_instances query in get_standards_page) into a TodayInstance dict. Fields: source_standard_id (str), dish_name (str), meal_type (str), count (int), total_kcal (int), total_protein_g/total_carbs_g/total_fat_g/total_fiber_g/total_good_fat_g/total_meat_g/total_red_meat_g/total_sodium_mg (float). Private to standards.py.

files.role: New Sprint 04 page. Fetches GET /api/food/standards. Renders two sections: top (Today — aggregated today_instances) and bottom (Standards — all standard dishes grouped by meal_type). Handles loading, error, and empty states.

methods.name: StandardsPage
methods.purpose: Top-level Standards page. State: payload (StandardsPagePayload | null), isLoading (boolean), error (ApiError | null), actionError (ApiError | null). Fetches GET /api/food/standards on mount and after any add-copy or delete-one action. Renders Skeleton while loading. Renders ErrorCard on error. Renders two sections when loaded. Top section (Today): renders TodaySection with today_instances. Bottom section (Standards): renders StandardsSection with standards. actionError displays inline on action failure.

methods.name: TodaySection
methods.purpose: Renders the Today section. Each TodayInstance row shows: dish_name, meal_type, count (e.g. 'x 2'), total_kcal, total_protein_g, total_carbs_g, total_fat_g. Actions per row: 'Add copy' button (calls onAddCopy with source_standard_id), 'Delete one' button (calls onDeleteOne with source_standard_id). isActioning holds the source_standard_id currently being actioned; disable buttons for that row while actioning. Empty state: 'No standard dishes logged today' message.

methods.name: StandardsSection
methods.purpose: Renders the Standards section. Standards are grouped by meal_type. Each StandardDish row shows: dish_name and kcal. Clicking/selecting a row calls onLogCopy with the standard's id. isActioning holds the standard_id currently being actioned; disable the row while actioning. Empty state: 'No standards defined yet' message.
